item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:00 HKT 03/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, it will be generally fine and very hot over southern China in the next couple of days. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Hinnamnor will move across the East China Sea in the next couple of days towards the vicinity of the Korean Peninsula.
